name: DESTINI
recent: Destini 近期面临重大诉讼，因 Damen 仲裁案被令支付 RM18m，并预计需额外计提 RM4.14m 拨备。公司于 2026 年 9 月与 Siemens Mobility 签署为期两年的数字铁路维护、维修与运营（MRO）谅解备忘录。最新财报显示，2026 财年第四季度营收同比下滑 29.7%，净亏损 RM12.28m。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 9 月与 Siemens Mobility 签署为期两年的数字铁路 MRO 谅解备忘录。
公司因 Damen 仲裁案被令支付 RM18m，并预计需额外计提 RM4.14m 拨备。
公司将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日召开第 22 届常年股东大会。
risks: 公司因 Damen 仲裁案被令支付 RM18m，并预计需额外计提 RM4.14m 拨备。
最新季度净亏损 RM12.28m，亏损同比扩大。
公司有多项重大诉讼公告（2026 年 11 月 13 日及 16 日）。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度营收为 RM63.45m，同比下降 29.7%，环比下降 24.2%；净亏损为 RM12.28m，净利率为 -19.4%，而上一季度净利率为 4.1%。

recent_en: Destini is facing material litigation, having been ordered to pay RM18m in the Damen arbitration, with an expected additional RM4.14m provision. The company signed a two-year MoU with Siemens Mobility in September 2026 for digital railway MRO. The latest quarterly results show 4QFY2026 revenue down 29.7% YoY and a net loss of RM12.28m.
notable_en: The company signed a two-year digital railway MRO MoU with Siemens Mobility in September 2026.
The company was ordered to pay RM18m in the Damen arbitration and expects an additional RM4.14m provision.
risks_en: The company was ordered to pay RM18m in the Damen arbitration and expects an additional RM4.14m provision.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM12.28m, with losses widening YoY.
The company has multiple material litigation announcements (13 and 16 November 2026).
earnings_en: 4QFY2026 revenue was RM63.45m, down 29.7% YoY and 24.2% QoQ; net loss was RM12.28m with a net margin of -19.4%, compared to a net margin of 4.1% in the previous quarter.
